content:
sarah: heads up — we saw a 3min egress/egress-burst in eu-west that coincided with a couple of high-CPU nvlink jobs. tenant t-57 experienced 4x latency for short-lived requests. link to alert: https://go/alerts/INC-33421
infra-bot: [ALERT] eu-west: egress-sawtooth spike on host gpu-rack-12 (03:12 UTC)
oliver: reassigning — looks like NIC queue blowup from a bursty batch job. did the perf team run the mem-cgroup patch on that host recently?
maya: no patch on that host. I triggered a live repro earlier with a load generator, saw NIC tail latency climb and then pcie stalls. short jobs block longer ones.
sarah: proposal: add a short "burst-shield" debounce before routing fallback kicks in. basically require 2 consecutive windowed spikes before we move traffic to dedicated slices. cheaper than immediate quarantine. thoughts?
cheng: +1 to debounce but ensure we track tokenized cost delta. debounce too long => SLA hits. Maybe adaptive: 10s window if p95 < target, 30s if noisy neighbor score < threshold.
oliver: also add a soft-tag action: mark tenant as "preferred-shed" and shadow-route 20% traffic to warm-pool for 60s. if still bad, escalate to full offload. keeps impact gradual.
maya: pseudo: ```yaml
policy:
  detection_window: 10s
  spike_threshold: 3x
  shadow_rate: 0.2
  escalate_after: 30s
```
maya: runbook link: https://go/runbooks/noisy-neighbor#burst-shielding
sarah: what about cost — shadowing to warm-pool will increase reserved GPU usage. finance will ask. any cheap mitigations?
cheng: could favor quantized variants for shadowed requests when applicable — lower GPU memory and egress usage. Not always possible but helps.
oliver: I'd rather avoid mass dedicated moves for short bursts. we should also add a host-level NIC qdisc tweak as temporary mitigation: `tc qdisc change dev eth0 root fq_codel limit 1000` — reduces tail for small packets.
maya: tested `fq_codel` on dev rack — improved 99th by ~20ms. will open a small PR to roll to eu-west staging.
sarah: action items: 1) oliver - add debounce + soft-shadow policy draft by EOD 2) maya - PR for fq_codel rollout to staging 3) cheng - quantify cost delta for shadowing and quantized fallback 4) ops - monitor alert for 2hr window and tag incidents.
cheng: noted. I'll compute cost delta and add to the PR comments.
oliver: assigning ticket INF-4823 for policy work. ping me if you need infra creds.
infra-bot: Note: deploys to eu-west staging scheduled at 04:00 UTC — watch for regressions. :eyes:
